subsystems.name: Editing machinery
subsystems.role: cuts specific DNA sequences to disable or modify target genes.

subsystems.name: Delivery and transformation
subsystems.role: introduces the editing components into plant cells.

subsystems.name: Regeneration system
subsystems.role: grows edited single cells into whole fertile plants.

subsystems.name: Target trait genes
subsystems.role: the genes edited to improve drought and salinity tolerance.

subsystems.name: Phenotyping and selection
subsystems.role: measures tolerance and selects the best lines.

subsystems.name: Seed production
subsystems.role: multiplies edited lines into enough seed for farmers.

buildSteps.title: Select target genes
buildSteps.detail: Identify genes controlling drought or salinity response from natural variation, mutant screens, or known pathways.

buildSteps.title: Design guide RNAs
buildSteps.detail: Use bioinformatics to choose sequences that cut only the intended gene, minimising off-target edits.

buildSteps.title: Deliver into plant cells
buildSteps.detail: Introduce the CRISPR components into callus tissue, embryos, or protoplasts using Agrobacterium or a gene gun.

buildSteps.title: Regenerate edited plants
buildSteps.detail: Culture the edited cells on media with hormones to induce shoots and roots, producing whole plants.

buildSteps.title: Screen and validate edits
buildSteps.detail: Genotype the regenerated plants by PCR and sequencing to confirm the intended change and check for unwanted edits.

buildSteps.title: Test under stress
buildSteps.detail: Grow the best lines in greenhouses and then multi-location field trials where drought or salinity naturally occurs.

buildSteps.title: Obtain regulatory approval
buildSteps.detail: Submit safety and performance data to authorities; rules for gene-edited crops vary by country.

buildSteps.title: Scale up seed
buildSteps.detail: Multiply approved lines through seed production and distribute them to farmers.

prerequisites.why: the core tool for making precise, targeted changes in plant DNA.
many staple crops are still difficult to regenerate from single edited cells.

prerequisites.tech: Genetic basis of drought and salinity tolerance
prerequisites.why: these are complex, multi-gene traits, so single edits often give only modest gains.
to prove real-world tolerance, thousands of lines must be measured accurately under stress.
some countries have light-touch rules, others treat gene-edited crops like GMOs, affecting release.

pathway.milestone: proof-of-concept edits in model crops and greenhouse trials
pathway.unlocks: understanding which gene edits actually improve tolerance.

pathway.milestone: multi-location field trials in drought- and salt-affected regions
pathway.unlocks: real-world performance data and agronomic packages.

pathway.milestone: first regulatory approvals and commercial release of climate-resilient varieties
pathway.unlocks: farmers can plant seed that survives harsher conditions.

pathway.milestone: stacking multiple tolerance traits and broad adoption
pathway.unlocks: more stable food production as climate extremes intensify.
